disclosure.immutability: Additive only. The OP-MC acceptance standard, the genesis manifest and the genesis verdict stand exactly as published and remain independently fetchable and hashable. Nothing is re-scored.

op_mc.note: The verdict stands as published. It is not revised, softened or withdrawn by this addendum.

successor.fee_sanity_2026-09-29: 7 collector days in: the collector's decoded fee growth, summed over each pool's active liquidity for 7 days, matches DexScreener's 24h volume x fee tier x 7 within 3x on 17 of 21 pools (the largest pools within 0.96-1.54x). The 4 outside are two Velodrome Slipstream pools with dynamic fees and staked liquidity (whose fees go to the gauge, so total-liquidity x fee growth overstates them) and two pools with under $50 of weekly fees. Fee estimates are displayed, not graded.

disclosure.summary: OP-MC froze one genesis cohort (2026-08-25) under its own acceptance standard and published one verdict on 2026-09-10: NO_EDGE_DETECTED. No further OP-MC cohort was pre-registered, so no other OP-MC verdict is owed. The raw collector behind it (op-capture, every 3 minutes since 2026-07-29) is stopped here; its database is archived, hash-verified and then removed from the server. OP v2 - probability-of-breach forecasts on Optimism pools, graded on each pool's own on-chain price under a standard sealed before its first forecast - is the successor.

title: OP-MC closed: collection stopped; the genesis verdict stands; superseded by OP v2
